@@@@ text
// browserGlass v1: generated by the DMS plugin browserGlass, do not edit.
// Firefox-family browsers paint their own translucency (glass backgrounds,
// opaque text, images and videos): niri must not dim the whole window.
window-rule {
    match app-id=r#"^(firefox|firefox-esr|librewolf|zen|zen-browser|zen-beta|floorp|waterfox|org\.mozilla\.firefox|io\.gitlab\.librewolf-community|app\.zen_browser\.zen|one\.ablaze\.floorp|net\.waterfox\.waterfox)$"#
    opacity 1.0
}
